lines.zh: 我踩在遗迹石板上，爪子很响。
lines.en: My claws ring on the ruin's slabs.

lines.zh: 我从蛋里出来的地方，就在这附近。
lines.en: I hatched somewhere near here.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，但每一步都很稳。
lines.en: I walk slowly, but every step is sure.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴拖在身后，扫过碎石。
lines.en: My tail drags behind, sweeping rubble.

lines.zh: 我沿着断墙走，找一个入口。
lines.en: I walk the broken wall, looking for a way in.

lines.zh: 我的鳞是青铜色的，在暗处发亮。
lines.en: My bronze scales glint in the dark.
I walk toward the clatter of shell.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，石子都翻了。
lines.en: Stones turn over where I pass.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀收着，走路更省力。
lines.en: Wings folded, walking costs me less.

lines.zh: 我从龙之手遗迹里出来。
lines.en: I come out of the Dragon Hand ruin.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在地面留下三道痕。
lines.en: My claws leave three lines on the ground.
I close in step by step, unhurried.
I stand with my wings slightly open.
This body will grow more.
I listen to the echo in the ruin.
My breath carries a little heat.
The edges of my scales are blunt.
I lower my head and sniff the ground.

lines.zh: 我在等一个够格的东西。
lines.en: I wait for something worthy.
This place was not empty before.
My horns have not finished growing.
I look at my own claws.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地打了一个呵欠。
lines.en: I yawn slowly.
My scales scrape the stone wall.

lines.zh: 我记得从蛋里看出去的影子。
lines.en: I remember a shadow seen from inside the egg.
I raise my head. The sky is above the broken wall.
You do not smell of dragon.

lines.zh: 你站在遗迹里，不像来寻宝的。
lines.en: You stand in the ruin, but not like a treasure seeker.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀可以张得很大。
lines.en: My wings can spread wide.
Do not put your hand on my neck.
I do not mind you standing there.
The iron on you is a little bright.

lines.zh: 我记得有人也这样看过我。
lines.en: I remember someone looking at me like that.

lines.zh: 那个人没能拿走我的蛋。
lines.en: That one did not get my egg.
I am weighing you up.
A scale dropped from my shoulder.
I give a stretch, bracing on my forelimbs.

lines.zh: 这一下，打在我翅膀根上。
lines.en: That hit the base of my wing.

lines.zh: 我的血很烫，落在地上冒烟。
lines.en: My blood is hot and smokes on the stone.
This will heal.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在地上刮了一下。
lines.en: My claws rake the ground once.
I have marked you.
Try that once more, if you dare.
Not a dragon's fare.
You hold meat up to a dragon.
This piece is far too small.
I can smell the blood on you.
That will not even catch in my teeth.
Before eating, I look at you.
The smell is nothing special.
Take it. I am not hungry.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的肩鳞，弹开了。
lines.en: You bounced off my shoulder scales.
Not one claw moved.
Move. I walk this path.
Your hand should hurt after that.
My scales are harder than you.
You gave a step and a half.
We scattered the rubble.
Do not walk against my wing.
I turn my shoulder to make a gap.
Again, and my teeth come out.
I am not grown to that yet.
My kind are few. Fewer in ruins.

lines.zh: 我从蛋里出来时，只有自己。
lines.en: When I hatched, I was alone.
That would require beating me first.
Not in these ruins.
My scale colour will change.
Wait until I am bigger.

lines.zh: 我听见遗迹深处有声音。
lines.en: I hear something deep in the ruin.
That is not one of my kind.
Out of these ruins.
I pick up a scale.
This is a scale I shed.
It can be made into armor.
This scale, I keep.
This bone is hard.
It is thicker than my own bones.

lines.zh: 我把它埋进巢底的灰里。
lines.en: I bury it in the ash of my nest.
This smells of fire.
This egg is not mine.
I push it back into the slab crack.
Your shadow shifted.
Two steps at this distance.
Something gathers in my throat.
The broken wall is behind you.
First a low growl, to test you.
You did not retreat.
Then we fight.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴扫倒了遗迹石柱。
lines.en: My tail knocks over a ruin pillar.
First I will pin you down.
Then we fight before we speak of eggs.
I see the gap.
The Dragon Hand's heir is here.

lines.zh: 我一步一步逼近石板那端。
lines.en: I close on the far end of the slab.
You retreat; I follow.

lines.zh: 你改了方向，我的尾巴跟着扫。
lines.en: You change course; my tail sweeps after.

lines.zh: 这里的碎石绊脚，我记得。
lines.en: The rubble catches feet. I remember.
Your armor is rattling.
Your back is to the broken wall.
The rubble reports your steps.
Half a body closer.
You slipped.
My claws come down trailing sparks.
My teeth are longer than a blade.
This charge sends you into the wall.
I bite into your armor.
The fire in my throat comes out.

lines.zh: 挡住了，可你的脚跟没钉住。
lines.en: You blocked it. Your heels still slid.
You are pressed against the broken wall.
My claws leave three lines.
I am satisfied with that.
Still standing. Interesting.
I draw my claws back a stretch.
Next time I will not hold back.
This is as far as it goes.
I break the shell, horns first.

lines.zh: 遗迹里很暗，只有缝里的光。
lines.en: The ruin is dark, light only from cracks.

lines.zh: 刚出的鳞软，一会儿就硬了。
lines.en: New scales are soft, then set.
I stand, and fall on the slabs.

lines.zh: 第一次呼吸，全是石灰味。
lines.en: My first breath tastes of lime.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀湿着，贴在背上。
lines.en: My wings are wet against my back.

lines.zh: 这里有很多骨头，没有活物。
lines.en: Many bones here. Nothing alive.
I crawl toward the light.
My claws scrape the slabs.
I remember the sound before hatching.
It was a hand knocking.
I raise my head and see the sky.
I choose this slab as home.
From here, I must first learn to walk.
There is a little heat in my throat.
I try to let it out.
Fire is only warmth to me.

lines.zh: 我从断墙上摔下，砸碎一片石板。
lines.en: I fall from the wall and shatter slabs.

lines.zh: 水灌进我的喉咙，火灭了。
lines.en: Water floods my throat and the fire dies.

lines.zh: 碎石埋住了我半个身子。
lines.en: Rubble buries half of me.

lines.zh: 一支箭卡在我的颈鳞里。
lines.en: An arrow lodges between my neck scales.
A curse slips under my scales, cold.
Too empty to unfold my wings.

lines.zh: 雷打在鳞上，我全身一麻。
lines.en: Lightning hits my scales and numbs me.

lines.zh: 脚下没有石板，我往下落。
lines.en: No slab below; I fall.
